label: DISARM2 system
definition: A DISARM system in which an organism possesses a genome-encoded DefenseFinder DISARM_2 subtype locus represented by DISARM_2__drmE, DISARM_2__drmMII, DISARM__drmA, DISARM__drmB, and DISARM__drmC rule profiles.
observations: DISARM2 branch under DISARM system; distinct from the broader DISARM system, the individual DISARM_2 and shared DISARM HMM profile rows, unresolved DISARM2 effector chemistry, native host breadth, sensitive-phage breadth, exact shared-core component roles, and DISARM1.
